notes.title: Freedom Tower broadcast at Storyteller's Festival!
notes.notes:
Dear Tower,

We will be broadcasting the prototype gameplay of our game live at 5:00 PM GMT time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/b5e36b3bd18ed5aa8befbbabebc56067b60f4b3f.png[/img]

Join in, and feel free to leave your questions in the Community Hub.

Thanks for being with us!

notes.title: Freedom Tower’s festive season starts!
notes.notes:
Dear Tower, 

As winter passes, we are back from break to begin 2024 with participation in community events and thrilling announcements!  

Foremost, we want to thank [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios]Two and a Half Studios[/url] for hosting [url=https://t.co/hXDzoXJ03p]#TheStorytellersFestival[/url]! Fables set off all great adventurers, determined to become a tale that will ignite one's spark in the future. Our story of the great Ukrainian tradition of resistance is based on a vast cultural heritage of folklore, myths, legends, and historical records. 

The grand celebration of tales and the art of storytelling will begin [url=https://t.co/hXDzoXJ03p]here [/url]on January 29th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/3ceb9480df0f4e0b124e79329d58a0819cc431e1.png[/img]

Also, we are excited to announce that Freedom Tower will be showcased during the [url=https://t.co/EeA1B0Xyhf]#GamesInSweden [/url]hosted by [url=https://twitter.com/FireshineGames]Fireshine Games[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/914963527bca5969ac82c6f3fa4cf158ac76fae5.jpg[/img]

Even though our team is scattered around Europe and Ukraine, we share a deep mutual sense of courage and craftsmanship, as yellow and blue represent freedom and dignity in Sweden and Ukraine.

notes.title: Freedom Tower — Harvest of News
notes.notes:
Dear Tower, 

Autumn has always been a season of significant milestones for us, and now we are happy to share some updates regarding the Freedom Tower development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/687356b127a93ede629f18ce17c8f5f7fe5c8806.jpg[/img]

Firstly, we are delighted to announce our participation in Turn-Based Carnival hosted by Acram Digital! 

Get a chance to celebrate the brave spirit of indie developers and discover new fascinating worlds with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/3845f78240c8c0ab02f875c49bfaafd6f75a9ea3.jpg[/img]

Secondly, we are proud to present a handful of improvements to the UI, VFX, level design and overall feel of the Ozera village scene. Encouraged by your feedback and sincere support, we are continuing to polish our pipeline. You can check out the new walkthrough and trailer on our updated YouTube channel! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@EternalGamesUA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/15a0d77ca27cc66b735ac3870f1704fb1167a762.png[/img][/url]

Finally, we are honoured to be among the Ukrainian indie developers presenting games at Indie Cup Ukraine ’23! We are proud to be a part of Ukrainian game development industry, and humbled to represent our stories, our heritage, and our creative passion to the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/72877a13641533e1c8aa2ac2d284525bbe140509.jpg[/img]

We are already excited about the upcoming challenges, and can't wait to share more news in the future! 

Thanks for being with us! You are among the fearless. You are the Tower.

notes.title: Freedom Tower Developer’s Diary — Ukrainian Games Festival
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow freedom fighters!

We are honored to be among the best Ukrainian game development creatives, who are presented at the Ukrainian Games Festival 2023! At times of great darkness and cruelty, the fire in our hearts will warm the spirit as the light of hope will clear the path to Freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/e3f09b373cc6de46368b1d39c88ed08486320e24.png[/img]

We are inviting you to share with us the joy of the devoted craftsmanship that shapes the stories into worlds and bewitches the mind to ignite the senses.

In a matter of days, Ukraine will celebrate its 32 Independence Day. Even though the tradition of our fight for freedom is full of victories and centuries of wars, we are determined to protect our home and the right to live freely.

So, please, have a close look at our virtual treasury! We are sure that even kings and queens will find a gem to their taste!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2023


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/8afac7655a27dfb4d471e47f4d77817fc65fc047.jpg[/img]

The campfire is warm and luring, take your seat and make sure you get to know our fellow developers! Then, if you dare, of course, find your way to the Tower, find your way to us!

notes.title: Freedom Tower Developer’s Diary — August 2023
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! My name is Anna Mikhel, and I'm a Lead Artist at Eternal Games! Today I'm going to tell you a story full of adventure, desperation, the desire for independence and freedom, where fire either warms or burns!

Welcome to Freedom Tower, our debut narrative game inspired by the struggle for Ukrainian independence after World War I and the mysticism of our folklore.
I hope you are ready to fight for what you truly believe in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/dc152cd706f6d3d9c9a713ed636fd49c642fa760.png[/img]

[b]The camp's fire
[/b]
We met one winter evening in late February 2023 at Gamedev Camp, a mentoring program for developers from Eastern Europe. As the organizers put it afterwards: it's a rare thing when it's obvious that people sound and work in unison. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/81506ddceb190f3d19f58b6a4125331584917185.jpg[/img]

Don't get me wrong, we had a lot of debates, fights, and rejected ideas. I'm sure we will have more in the future, but it was more about constant practical testing of millions of ideas and endless brainstorming. When there are only four of you, everyone can have an impact on decision-making. We never stopped trying out different theories for the story, game designs, visual styles, and 100 and 1 other aspects of game development. 

We had a lot of ideas, pitched them to each other, and although sometimes they seemed to be polar opposites, we mostly agreed that it had to be something important that would tell the story of our fight for freedom and touch people who share the philosophy of this fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/6dce3815226c01f63347f67ba1fa90e4d609856e.jpg[/img]

[b]The world of Freedom Tower
[/b]
We spent hours discussing the events of the national liberation movement. Realizing that we could not achieve historical accuracy, we chose a different path. Historical fiction with elements of fantasy and, potentially, steampunk! That is, the events of the game are not real, but I think we managed to achieve the emotional component of the fate of a young cadet of those times! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/d446fcc07be69e4ac824e8f5ec0d3d08b0df55e4.jpg[/img]

Imagine the world of the early twentieth century, where most of the continent is controlled by the evil totalitarian regime, the Black Empire. Orest, our protagonist, is a cadet at an imperial military school who will have to choose a path according to what he is willing to live for. 

Rumor has it that a guerrilla struggle is still smoldering in remote villages and city catacombs - the Tower rebels. These are people with completely different histories, they may even speak different languages, but they continue to fight for the opportunity to live freely on their land in peace. 

There is also a third party, the mystical one. Molfars (mages) are mediators with the world of spirits and mythical creatures, and in the beta version we have just begun to unveil them.

[b]The first events
[/b]
We're currently participating in various events dedicated to game development and applying for contests. We have recently taken part in Games Gathering, the biggest game development conference in Ukraine.

We are happy to be participating in the Ukrainian Games Festival on Steam that kicks off August 18.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/269d6d33f8951dddcec87bea1107df06489217be.png[/img]

Only the Carpathian Molfars will be able to reveal further milestones in this adventure.
The Tower of Babel may have remained unfinished, but that doesn't mean that people won't return to the dream of touching the sky!
